question.text:
Match List I with List II
\(\begin{array}{llll}
\text{List - I} & \text{List - II} \\
\text{(Pair of compounds)} & \text{(Isomerism)} \\
\text{(A) n-propanol and Isopropanol} & \text{(I) Metamerism} \\
\text{(B) Methoxypropane and ethoxyethane} & \text{(II) Chain Isomerism} \\
\text{(C) Propanone and propanal} & \text{(III) Position Isomerism} \\
\text{(D) Neopentane and Isopentane} & \text{(IV) Functional Isomerism} \\
\end{array}\)
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text:
$\qquad$ $\Rightarrow$ Position isomers
$\qquad$ $\Rightarrow$ Metamers
$\qquad$ $\Rightarrow$ Functional isomers
$\qquad$ $\Rightarrow$ Chain isomers
